problem:
Given that 

$$
\frac{5{x}^{2}-5x+12}{(2{x}^{2}+3)(x-3)}=\frac{x+B}{2{x}^{2}+3}+\frac{2}{x-3},
$$

what is the value of $B?$

feedback.problem:
Given that 

$$
\frac{5{x}^{2}-5x+17}{({x}^{2}+5)(x-2)}=\frac{Ax-1}{{x}^{2}+5}+\frac{3}{x-2},
$$

what is the value of $A?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Multiplying both sides of the given equality by $({x}^{2}+5)(x-2)$ gives

$$
\begin{aligned}5{x}^{2}-5x+17 & =(Ax-1)(x-2)+3({x}^{2}+5).\end{aligned}
$$

Letting $x=1$  gives

$$
\begin{aligned}5(1)^{2}-5(1)+17 & =(A(1)-1)(1-2)+3({1}^{2}+5) \\ 17 & =(A-1)(-1)+3(6) \\ 17 & =-A+1+18 \\ -2 & =-A \\ A & =2.\end{aligned}
$$
